column1: # Never edit by hand: change the lemma file and run it again.
# IT and chat Ukrainian, as lemmas with a paradigm class: the corpus lacks these words, and an
# overlay with one form of each made every other form a typo of it (фічу was corrected to фіча).
# scripts/expand-paradigms.py writes every form into uk-tech.tsv, which is merged into uk.txt by
# Tiers match uk-everyday.tsv: 180 for work and tech words, 165 for chat slang and for every word
# of three letters or fewer; every other form of a word is ranked 45 below it (135 or 120), under
# the everyday words its typos are near (мему stays under тему, 123). A word
# that is also a common word's neighbour stays at 165, under it; a form that is another word's is
# left out with !. Lowercase letters (with an apostrophe inside a word that has one) only, no names.
